narr: Flash flooding occurred as a stalled front and weak low pressure interacted in a tropical air-mass to generate showers and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall.
ev: Flash flooding was observed at the intersection of Kings Hwy at 10th Street. The road was impassable at this location due to deep water.
Flash flooding reported with numerous streets flooded across town.
Flash flooding led to a car stalling in 2 feet of water at 67th St. and Ballyhoo Drive.
lsr: KINGS HWY AT 10TH IMPASSABLE DUE TO FLOODING.
CAR STALLED IN TWO FEET OF WATER AT 67TH AND BALLYHOO.
